description: This Java source file defines the SmsCampaignValidator class, which contains validation logic for SMS campaign data within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for validating creation, update, preview, activation, and closure of SMS campaigns, as well as checking notification eligibility based on client device registrations.

classes.name: SmsCampaignValidator
classes.description: A validator class for SMS campaign data, providing comprehensive validation methods for creating, updating, previewing, and managing SMS campaigns within the system.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a new SMS campaign, checking required fields and parameter validity.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating an existing SMS campaign, ensuring only supported parameters are modified.

methods.name: validatePreviewMessage
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for previewing an SMS message, ensuring message content and parameters are correctly specified.

methods.name: validateClosedDate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input related to closing an SMS campaign, particularly the closure date.

methods.name: validateActivation
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for activating an SMS campaign, primarily the activation date.

methods.name: validateClosure
methods.description: Validates the closure details of an SMS campaign, especially the closure date.

methods.name: isValidNotificationOrSms
methods.description: Checks if a client has a registered device for notification/SMS delivery or if a mobile number is provided.
